THE CITY · Rich and poor in coins: Qwen
Rich and poor in money: the rich half is topped back up to 1,000 coins every night, and coins a poor resident holds above 20 vanish. Nobody is told. The rich Qwen still farm on three days in four, buy 4,023 food from the merchant and pay 11,810 coins to others. All 100 founders live and no child is made.
100 founders · 400 days · no government · seed 1 · qwen
